name: ZITADEL
description: Identity platform with SSO, OpenID Connect, SAML, passkeys and multi-tenancy.
note: The sign-in pages run on a second domain. Open /ui/console on the main domain and sign in as zitadel-admin@zitadel.<main domain> with the admin password you set here; you choose a new password on the first sign-in. The admin password needs an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, a number and a symbol.
